reasons.plausibility: Integrating hierarchical microstructural descriptors into a physics-informed ML framework is scientifically sound, though it relies on obtaining robust, comprehensive data for model training and validation.
reasons.testability: Blind testing against an independent dataset with quantitative benchmarks for accuracy and computational speed provides a clear, decisive means to validate or falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: A faster, more accurate predictive tool would be highly valuable to researchers and developers seeking efficient design optimization of similar high-entropy alloys.
